# SpotipyFree

> Python library with a Spotipy-style interface for Spotify catalog, account,
> and playback operations.

SpotipyFree supports track search; track, album, artist, and playlist lookups;
authenticated account and playback features; recently played collection; and
an optional local Flask interface. SpotipyFree is independent and is not
affiliated with Spotify.
